kept.poolKey: First-Survey qualification (the reading is a first look)
kept.spine: The safety reading for Rundgate is a first one. It is honest about what has been seen and silent about what has not.
A stranger at Rundgate is not robbed outright but is quietly told what the arrangement is, the danger here being organized rather than sudden.
The hall at Rundgate moves against the operators working the town, and the operators move back, with the town caught between the two.
Every way into Rundgate is held at the town's own choosing. What a perimeter buys is not safety outright, but the choice of where anything happens.
A standing force is kept in Rundgate. Their work is the defense of the town, and they are answerable for it as work, not as duty owed.
The town pays for some of its soldiers and knows exactly which ones. They are treated accordingly, paid work rather than sworn duty.
A traveller at Rundgate finds a hall whose business is the kind of trouble a garrison is the wrong tool for, and finds that hall busy.
